meta.name: InkNote compact desktop editor
meta.description: A calm, desktop-native, three-column note workspace derived from the user-supplied reference screenshots. It uses compact information density, warm neutral surfaces, crisp system typography, restrained blue selection, and small semantic accents for notes, tags, and status.

color.palette_type: neutral monochrome with restrained semantic accents

primary.role: high-contrast ink for titles, body copy, and editor content

secondary.role: muted navigation layer, separators, and inactive chrome

accent.role: interactive selection, focus, timestamps, and primary metadata

neutral.usage: Use warm white and light gray for document surfaces, a slightly darker gray for sidebar layers and dividers, #656e6e for supporting copy, and #1b1b19 for primary foreground text. Avoid high-saturation fills except for semantic chips and selection.

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant with subtle surface steps; active selection uses an accessible blue-tinted neutral layer plus text and icon changes rather than color alone

font_families.heading: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
font_families.body: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Use the operating system’s native sans on desktop for a quiet macOS-like finish. Keep markdown source and code blocks in a legible monospaced face with generous line height.

spacing.section_rhythm: Tight 4–8px grouping within controls, 12–16px between related content clusters, and 24–32px around document sections.

layout.grid_system: fixed compact three-column desktop workspace: navigation, note list, and document area split into source and rendered preview
layout.columns: 220–250px navigation; 280–320px note list; flexible editor and preview panes
layout.breakpoints: 1440px retains all columns; 1024px narrows sidebars; below 768px use a single active panel with explicit navigation controls
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with aligned toolbar, pane, and list boundaries

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px dividers define workspace panes; use gentle borders for inputs, chips, code blocks, and controls
shape.divider_style: 1px rgba(27, 27, 25, 0.10) lines with no heavy card outlines

elevation.shadow_style: minimal soft diffused shadows only for transient menus and floating tools
elevation.depth_cues: surface tone, dividers, selected-row tint, and occasional low shadow rather than persistent card elevation

iconography.style: thin rounded line icons with simple filled status dots where semantic meaning benefits from a colored fill
iconography.size_scale: 16px inline metadata, 18px controls, 20px navigation, 22px primary toolbar
iconography.preferred_set: existing InkNote hand-drawn consistent SVG icon primitives

motion.entrance_pattern: short opacity and background-color transition; no spring or decorative entrance
motion.exit_pattern: short opacity fade with stable layout where possible
motion.philosophy: minimal functional transitions that make selection, focus, and panel changes legible without adding visual noise

components.button_style: small ghost icon buttons with a 4–7px radius, subtle neutral hover fill, visible focus ring, and pressed tint
components.input_style: low-contrast white or translucent surface with a 1px border, 7px radius, and blue focus ring
components.card_style: avoid generic cards; panes are flat surfaces and only transient menus or rich code blocks use a bordered contained surface
components.navigation_pattern: compact vertically grouped navigation with section labels, live counts, hierarchy indentation, and a muted blue-gray selected state
components.modal_style: white elevated panel, 10px radius, precise 1px border, and restrained medium shadow
components.list_style: dense list rows with title, timestamp/progress/tag metadata, a two-line excerpt, and an accessible selected state
components.component_notes: Metadata uses small compact chips and no large primary CTA inside the note list; toolbar remains available across views.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a well-organized physical writing desk with indexed notebooks and a live proof sheet beside the draft
aesthetic.era_influence: modern macOS productivity software with restrained editorial tooling
aesthetic.genre: professional knowledge-management and markdown authoring application

visual_language.complexity: moderate information density with minimal ornament
visual_language.whitespace_usage: intentional and compact; document content is breathable while workspace chrome is dense
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: quiet sidebars and chrome frame the writing canvas, while current selection and document headings carry emphasis
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal from selection in sidebar to note metadata to editor and live rendered content
visual_language.contrast_level: moderate with dark text and gentle surface separation
visual_language.texture_usage: none; surfaces remain flat and clean

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy, pane boundaries, compact metadata, and one selected-row tint
composition.flow_direction: left-to-right from collection, to note, to draft and rendered proof
composition.grouping_strategy: thin dividers, small vertical rhythm, and grouped metadata chips
composition.negative_space_role: preserves reading comfort in editor and preview while keeping navigation dense

imagery.graphic_elements: line icons, colored status dots, slim progress bars, and compact tag chips

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, restrained, and stateful through selected tint, focus rings, tooltips, and semantic text
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle neutral fill on interactive rows and icon buttons
interaction_feel.loading_style: quiet inline status or skeleton that preserves pane structure
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low-to-moderate; each interaction earns a small state change rather than a decorative animation

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: subtle suggestion through icon buttons and contextual labels
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: brief practical direction that tells the writer what to do next

overview.fallback_strategy: static CSS presentation with all transitions disabled for reduced motion

background_effects.description: Flat warm-neutral application surfaces keep attention on writing.

particle_systems.description: No particles; the application is a focused writing environment.

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements; document readability takes priority.

shader_effects.description: No shader effects; static surfaces preserve performance and visual calm.

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll morphing; scroll positions remain functional and stable.

text_effects.description: Typography is static, sharp, and highly legible.

cursor_effects.description: Native pointer behavior is retained for familiar desktop interaction.

image_effects.description: No image treatment is required in the content-first workspace.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas drawing; CSS is sufficient for the product surface.

svg_animations.description: SVG icons are static and use CSS color transitions only.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The reference is deliberately effect-free. Fidelity comes from hierarchy, restrained color, accurate system typography, narrow dividers, compact row density, and correctly rendered Markdown rather than visual decoration.
